description:
Apply the workspace extras-preservation policy (JMAP-lbdy) to crate-jmap-contacts-types.

In scope (estimate ~3 public wire-shaped Deserialize structs):
- AddressBook, MyRights
- ContactCard

Out of scope:
- Filter / Comparator algebra (ContactCardFilterCondition, ContactCardComparator).
- Property selector enums.

Coordination: when JMAP-sehw lands new typed sub-types in jscontact.rs, those typed sub-types MUST also include `extra` per this policy. Add a cross-reference to JMAP-sehw description at landing time so the contributor remembers to include extras from day one.

Acceptance: every in-scope struct has `pub extra: Map<String, Value>` with the documented attributes; one round-trip preservation test per type; PLAN.md updated; cargo test/clippy/fmt clean.
